feeds.title: Hyperhidrosis UK Blog
feeds.description: This website contains information on hyperhidrosis for the benefit of patients and is provided by Limbco Ltd which is a family-run business based in Hereford, UK that specializes in products for people who have hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating) and warehousing and distribution for a large medical device company.

feeds.title: The Ejis Blog
feeds.description: The Ejis Blog is the man's guide to looking good and feeling your best when the stakes are high. It will equip you with bulletproof tips for commanding a room. No matter who you are - decision-maker, metal bender, cattle herder, wildfire slayer - you'll approach each encounter with self-assurance once you've added these style-defining techniques and confidence hacks to your repertoire.

feeds.title: International Hyperhidrosis Society Blog
feeds.description: International Hyperhidrosis Society is a nonprofit organization serving millions of people who suffer from excessive uncontrollable sweating and those who provide care. Online resources, treatment information, medical education, research, and advocacy. Our mission is to reduce the symptoms, anxiety, and social stigma associated with excessive sweating by improving the information, support, and treatment available to the millions of children, teens, and adults affected by hyperhidrosis worldwide.

feeds.title: My Life as a Puddle Blog
feeds.description: I'm a passionate writer, patient leader, and hyperhidrosis trailblazer. This is a blog about hyperhidrosis, mostly (I also have an autoimmune condition called ulcerative colitis [UC], so occasionally I might spill my guts to you). I've lived with hyperhidrosis nearly all of my life and offer a unique perspective on a condition that can be mentally, socially, emotionally, and professionally debilitating.

feeds.title: SweatySwaggy
feeds.description: The author of SweatySwaggy was diagnosed with palmar and plantar hyperhidrosis. In this blog, they share their lifestyle and tips and tricks on how to deal with excessive sweating for both men and women, based on personal experience and the latest trends.

feeds.title: Daavlin Blog » Hyperhidrosis
feeds.description: Explore our blog to wider your knowledge base on hyperhidrosis. Daavlin offers a complete line of phototherapy units designed to be used in the comfort, privacy, and convenience of your own home.

feeds.title: Sweat Block
feeds.description: SweatBlock was born in 2004 when Scott Steffensen, a renowned Ph.D., researcher, and professor struggled to find a solution for his own sweat problem. SweatBlock has become the foremost brand for excessive sweating and odor with products for underarms, hands, feet, face, and body.

feeds.title: Patient Worthy » Hyperhidrosis
feeds.description: Know more about hyperhidrosis and learn what affects it. Patient Worthy is an online publication that provides relevant information to rare disease patients, caregivers, and advocates alike. Our goal is to amplify the voices of those in the rare disease community, feature the institutions that serve them, and foster solidarity across diagnoses.

feeds.title: The Center for Hyperhidrosis Blog
feeds.description: Check out The Center for Hyperhidrosis blog to learn more about sweating, excessive blushing, our processes, and more! The Center for hyperhidrosis at Columbia University was established in the early 1990s and has been a leader in the field of hyperhidrosis treating thousands of patients over the years. Our commitment to this disorder is evident in our team approach to hyperhidrosis.

feeds.title: Duradry Blog
feeds.description: Duradry was created out of frustration with products that don't work. We formulated our products with science-backed ingredients to make sure they work for you. We keep iterating and improving our formulas, fragrances, and new releases based on your feedback.

feeds.title: Hyperhidrosis Center Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest blog posts, providing a range of resources for patients to stay informed on all things related to hyperhidrosis. At the Hyperhidrosis Center, our goal is to provide patients suffering from excessive sweating comprehensive services to treat and provide relief for hyperhidrosis. With years of combined experience to draw from, our team of professionals provides compassionate and personalized care for patients living with the hindering and embarrassing effects of excessive sweating.

feeds.title: Hyperhidrosis Network Blog
feeds.description: Hyperhidrosis Network has evolved way beyond what I originally thought it would. Since the time I started in 2012, the website has seen a surge of visitors from all across the globe - primarily through word of mouth. As more people have joined the website, the more useful it has become over all those months. At the core, HHN aims to be the single, authentic, non-biased, non-commercial source of information and community support for hyperhidrosis patients
